usageNotes: Use this to discover which CPU flags are available cluster-wide and which specific nodes support each flag under a given acceleration mode (KVM or TCG). This is the correct pre-flight call before enabling CPU flags in a VM's hardware config — consult `supported-on` to avoid scheduling a VM on a node that lacks the required flag. Note that aarch64 always returns an empty list; this endpoint is only meaningful for x86_64 workloads.

examples.summary: List all KVM-accelerated CPU flags for x86_64, showing which cluster nodes support each

tips: The `supported-on` field in each returned item is a list of node names — if it is absent or empty for a flag, no node in the cluster supports it under the chosen acceleration type.
When using TCG (software emulation), more flags may appear available than with KVM, but performance will differ significantly; always prefer KVM for production VMs.
Pair with CPU type enumeration (e.g., get_cluster_qemu_cpu) to understand which flags are already bundled into a chosen CPU model before adding individual flag overrides.
